syllabus: Unit 7 has the dictionary form, ない-form, た-form, 〜たことがある, 〜から (reason), 〜が (but), 〜でしょう, 〜と思います, 〜ほうがいい and 〜なければならない: a fair N5 set in a sensible order, given that the last three sit on the N5/N4 line and でしょうから and よくなる (unit 8) also appear?

n5u07d1.p1: The う-verb rows go from the い-row to the う-row (書きます → 書く); 入る → 入らない is noted as a る-ending う-verb. Clear for a beginner?
n5u07d1.c1: Answer 来ます. 来るか and 来ないか to a teacher fail as rude or wrong asks. Clearly wrong?
n5u07d1.d1: Many wrong options in this unit are made-up forms that are not words (読る, 買あない, こらない, いから, 行かないければ, ことをします, 雨車). Acceptable as distractors?
n5u07d1.d2: Answer する (テニスする？ without を). しる is a real verb. Clearly wrong? Natural without を?
n5u07d1.e3: Star item. Other orders (ばんごはんを見てえいがを食べる) are nonsense. Too easy?
n5u07d1.k: Door-memo scene: 今日 is one word read きょう. Fine as a scene word?
n5u07d1.r1: Quick response. The wrong replies contradict themselves (うん、来ない; ううん、行く). Too easy?
n5u07d2.p1: Drills and exam items here use casual plain speech (B「うちでべんきょうをした。」). Fine for exam-style N5 items?
n5u07d2.d2: Options are in kana (きた, こた, くった, くる) so the kanji does not give it away. Fine?
n5u07d2.d6: Star item. No comma after 読んで (本を読んでテレビは見なかった). Fine?
n5u07d2.e1: Answer した. Could して be heard as an unfinished casual reply? Clearly wrong?
n5u07d2.r1: The passage says 三年前にものぼったことがあります (a set time with 〜たことがある). Natural?
n5u07d3.p2: The watch note marks このかばんは高いでも、買います wrong. Is this a common learner mistake worth showing?
n5u07d3.c1: でも is wrong only by its position (here and d1), which may be easy. Fine?
n5u07d3.e1: Answer だから. Is 雨まで a sensible wrong option?
n5u07d3.k1: Is 店は午後四時にしまります natural? The wrong reading よっじ is made up. Fine?
n5u07d3.r1: Choices are plain forms; かぜをひいたから is never mentioned. Also uses だいすき, 母が国から来ます. Fine?
n5u07d4.p2: Written in kana (とおもいます) throughout. The watch note marks あの人は先生とおもいます wrong, but casual speech has it. Both fine?
n5u07d4.c1: The comparison tags are たぶん, わたしのいけん and ほんとう. Do they separate でしょう, とおもいます and です well?
n5u07d4.d3: Answer 来ない. 来なかった is wrong only because of あした. Clearly wrong?
n5u07d4.d5: Star item. The comma sits inside the tile ふって、. Fine?
n5u07d4.d6: Stars d6 and e3 seem easy. Fine?
n5u07d4.e1: Answer かえった. かえり is an odd fragment. Replace it?
n5u07d4.k: Weather-forecast scene. Day 4 also uses 天気よほう, はれる, はれ. All fair N5 words?
n5u07d4.r1: The option (今日は雨でさむかったから) may be too easy. Fine?
n5u07d5.d4: Answer なければなりません. ないほうがいいです is wrong only on meaning. Clearly wrong?
n5u07d5.d6: Rewritten after the check (tiles no longer split 飲まなければ). Please read once.
n5u07d5.e2: Answer 来なければ. 来なければ and 来なくても both read こ; only the kana differ. Is 来なくても clearly wrong before なりません?
n5u07d5.k: Doctor's-card scene. Day 5 also uses かぜ, のど, おふろ, いしゃ, びょういん, もって行く, はたらく. All fair N5 words?
n5u07d5.k1: The scene check is a 文脈規定 item (休んだ), not a kanji reading. Fine?
n5u07d6.c1: Comparison example 3 (この魚は今日、食べなければなりません) may sound stiff. Natural?
n5u07d6.d4: Answer 買わない. The explanation says 買わなかったほうがいい is not used. True in general?
n5u07d6.d5: Star item (雨がふるでしょうからかさを…). Is でしょうから above N5? ふるからでしょう fails only as the sentence goes on. Fair?
n5u07d6.e2: Rewritten after the check (option が replaced by を). Please read once.
n5u07d6.k: Teacher's-letter scene. Day 6 also uses ふじ山, くらい (dark), はやく, 大人, 子ども (prices). All fair N5 words?
n5u07d6.r1: The notice is 84 characters; 六百円 is a weak choice. Fine?
n5u07t.1: Answer がいこく. かいこく is a real word, not N5; そとくに and がいごく are made up. Fine?
n5u07t.6: Answer 古い. 安い and 高い are ruled out only by もう. Clearly wrong?
n5u07t.8: Answer にくがきらいです. Is すきじゃありません close enough to きらい?
n5u07t.17: Star item (天気がよくなるでしょう). よくなる is taught in unit 8; also easy and close to the day 4 passage. Fine?
n5u07t.18: Uses かぶる; the test also has ニュース, うけつけ, 大人. All N5 words?
n5u07t.24: The question asks もって行かなければなりませんか; the letter says もって来てください. Fair match?
